name: Construct
identity: Build a small set of Modules and choose which one works each round. Convert spent partner resources into Scrap, and use Corrosion to disrupt the enemy’s next status gain.
loop: Gather Scrap → install distinct Modules → choose the part you need this round → use Calibration for a planned number → apply Corrosion to disrupt enemy status gains.
statuses: The first time each round one of your Modules is dismantled or destroyed, gain 1 Scrap afterward. During Offensive, spend 2 Scrap to install a Module. You may install only one Module each round, including installs from cards and abilities. Keep unused Scrap.
Positive equipment · you · max 2 different Modules

Install Ram, Recycler or Plating. At the start of Offensive, choose one installed Module to use this round. Ram adds 1 damage to your damaging Offensive ability. Recycler gives 1 Scrap the first time you spend a different positive status, such as Flow or Charge. Plating prevents 1 damage from the first attack that would damage you. Each Module works once per round. Keep installed Modules until they are dismantled or destroyed.

The next time this enemy would gain a positive status, remove 1 Corrosion and reduce that gain by 1 stack. Use only one Corrosion against each card, ability or automatic status gain. Energy and card draws are unchanged. Keep unused Corrosion.
Positive die mark · your combat die · max 1

Mark one of your combat dice and choose a number from 1 to 6. During Offensive, after rolling that die, you may remove Calibration to change it to the chosen number. You cannot change a Frostbound die. Remove unused Calibration after your next Offensive segment.
abilities: Gain 2 Scrap and install one Module you do not already have if fewer than two are installed. Install at most one Module per round.
Deal 4 damage and apply 2 Corrosion. Optionally spend 1 Scrap when choosing this ability for +2 damage.
Deal 6 damage. Optionally dismantle one installed Module when choosing this ability for +3 damage; you can no longer use that Module after dismantling it.
Each Gear prevents 1; each Rivet gains 1 Scrap. If you roll any Core and have no Calibration, mark one of your combat dice with Calibration and choose its stored number.
Gear: prevent 2. Rivet: prevent 3. Core: prevent 2 and apply 1 Corrosion to the attacker.
cards: Install a Module you do not already have. You must have fewer than two installed Modules and must not have installed one yet this round.
Gain Calibration on one of your combat dice, choosing 1 or 4 as its stored number.
Spend up to 2 Scrap; add 2 damage each to your attack.
Dismantle one installed Module; gain 1 Energy. Its Scrap reward is limited once per round.
Spend 1 Scrap to replace one installed Module with a different one you do not have. This counts as your one install this round. Replacing it does not earn the Scrap reward for dismantling.
Choose a different installed Module to use for the rest of this round. A Module that already worked this round cannot work again; changing programs does not refresh it.
Spend 2 Scrap; return one of your cards previously lost to damage to your discard pile.
Prevent 2 from one attack, card or status.
Spend 1 Scrap; prevent 3 from one attack, card or status.
Spend 1 Scrap; stop 1 negative status stack an enemy is about to apply to you.
Shift the number on one of your combat dice that is not Frostbound by 1 without going below 1 or above 6. Your final dice must still allow the ability you choose.
Reroll one of your dice just rolled for a status, defense or card once; does not reset any module.
Remove 1 existing Corrosion from yourself; gain 1 Scrap. Requires Corrosion.
Spend 1 Scrap; reduce prevention from one enemy Defensive ability by 2, minimum zero.
Dismantle one of your Modules to prevent 4 damage from one attack, card or status. If this is your first dismantled or destroyed Module this round, earn 1 Scrap afterward.
Move your Calibration to another of your combat dice. Keep the stored number and the original time when Calibration expires.
Upgrade once per battle: your first Module dismantled or destroyed each round gives 2 Scrap instead of 1.
Spend 2 Scrap; gain 1 Armor and install one missing Module if allowed. No slot means Armor only.
Spend 3 Scrap. After your Defensive ability and protective statuses, halve the damage left from one attack, rounding down. Then apply prevention from damage-reaction cards.
pairs: Spending Charge while Recycler is active earns Scrap for later construction. Ground collects more Charge when an enemy pays for cards; each reward keeps its own once-per-round limit.

Spending Flow while Recycler is active earns Scrap. On another round, Plating can prevent attack damage and earn Flow. Choosing the active Module makes this a round-to-round cycle, not an unlimited exchange.
Plating and Armor can combine to stop attack damage and earn Resolve. Scrap can buy Foundry Reserve for more Armor. Spending Armor does not count as dismantling a Module and gives no salvage.
Calibration guarantees a chosen number while Favor nudges a number by one. Either can finish an ability, but neither earns Boon rewards. Real rerolls remain the way to grow Streak.
example: Choose Recycler at the start of Offensive. Spending Charge on a Storm card then gives 1 Scrap, once that round. On a later round, choose Plating instead to block 1 attack damage. Installing both Modules does not make both work at once.
counter: Dismantling a Module removes a lasting benefit, even if it gives a strong immediate card effect. Cleanse Corrosion before a valuable status gain. Calibration can be disrupted before its number is used.
balance: Install at most one Module per round and keep at most two different Modules. A newly installed Module is available to choose next Offensive; Change Program can activate it sooner. Switching does not refresh a Module that already worked. Corrosion removes only one stack from a gain, not the whole effect.
combos: Assembly Kit → Recycler → partner resource spend
Install Recycler, then activate it next Offensive. Spending Flow or Charge supplies Scrap for another Module. Spending Scrap itself does not feed Recycler.
Acid Primer → enemy setup → Core Hammer
Corrosion reduces an enemy’s next positive status gain. While they rebuild, Core Hammer can dismantle one of your Modules for a stronger attack, earning limited salvage afterward.

Scrap.example: You dismantle Ram for Core Hammer, then gain one Scrap. The lost Ram no longer improves your attacks.

Module.job: Choose which installed part works this round.
Module.example: Recycler is active. Spend Flow on a Tide card and gain one Scrap. More Flow spending this round gives no extra Scrap.

Corrosion.job: Interfere with an enemy’s resource or protection supply.
Corrosion.example: Culture Flask would give 2 Catalyst. Corrosion removes itself and lets the enemy gain only 1 Catalyst.

Calibration.job: Set up one reliable result in advance.
Calibration.example: You calibrate a die to 6. Next Offensive it rolls 2; spend Calibration to make it a 6 without rerolling.
